_comment: Fit is baked into the Fashion Sense model at pack build time. FS reads HeadPosition ONCE when the content pack loads, so there is no live runtime offset: a change here needs a pack rebuild and a game restart. Values must be INTEGERS — a float, even 0.0, makes FS reject the whole model as invalid JSON and load no hats at all, silently. Units are SPRITE pixels; at Scale 4 one sprite pixel is four screen pixels. NEGATIVE Y moves the hat DOWN (measured, session 20260907-011855).

targets.note: the four reference hats; vanilla median is 51

HatScale.supported: yes — our earlier finding was wrong
HatScale.correction: authored/fit.json previously recorded 'Fashion Sense ignored a top-level Scale field: soft_cap drawn at Scale 3, 4 and 5 rendered identically'. That experiment placed Scale at the TOP LEVEL of hat.json, where it is not a property of any model. Scale is a per-direction property of AppearanceModel (src/AppearanceModel.cs:35, 'public float Scale { get; set; } = 4f;') and is documented at wiki/Scale-Property. FS did not ignore it; we never set it.
HatScale.status: UNTESTED by us in-game. No official Example Pack file declares Scale, so the correction rests on the C# model field and the wiki, not on a working example. Re-test with Scale inside each direction block before relying on it.
HatScale.where: inside FrontHat / RightHat / LeftHat / BackHat, alongside HatSize
HatScale.note: Scale 4 is 1:1 with the farmer's pixel grid. Non-integer ratios still risk resampling against a 4x farmer, so authoring size remains preferable where possible.

soft_cap_refit.why: The cap base was redrawn (crown 10 -> 14 sprite px wide, envelope now rows 3-11 front / 4-12 back, identical to felt_hat). The old art measured 40x32 screen px with its top 4 px BELOW felt's, which is the 'too small, sitting on the forehead' complaint.
soft_cap_refit.offset: HatOffsetY -2 is unchanged and now correct by construction: fit is a property of the frame, and the cap's drawn rows are now the same rows as felt_hat, which seats correctly at -2.
soft_cap_refit.confirm_with: one capture session after the next pack rebuild + restart; compare front_hatonly bbox against Dec01FeltPlain
